changelog: Add a single narrow binding rule that keeps numerals/quantifiers attached to their immediately following measurement unit or parenthesized measurement phrase to fix splits that lose units (addresses the primary finding).

Insert a single, narrow binding that keeps a finite verb/auxiliary with its immediately following span when that span begins with surface tokens that indicate a core complement (prevents cuts that orphan verb complements).

Insert a single fallback ordering that prefers punctuation/clause-boundary cuts over cuts that split numerals from their units or separate finite verbs from their immediately following core complements — prevents the punctuation fallback from overriding the primary protections.

Insert a fallback ordering that prefers punctuation/clause-boundary cuts only when those punctuation cuts do not split a numeral from its immediately following unit or separate a finite verb/auxiliary from its immediately following core complement; otherwise prefer the cut that preserves numeral–unit or finite-verb–core-complement attachment. This prevents the punctuation-last-resort rule from overriding the primary attachment protections (addresses the primary finding).

delete C8: remove the disambiguating-span check because it restates other attachment/entailment principles, was blamed in the last iteration for leaking the punctuation-last-resort fallback into splits that break numeral–unit and verb–complement attachments, and is the weakest v0 unit by evidence.

Insert one induced ordering rule that prefers cuts which preserve numeral–unit and finite-verb–core-complement attachments, to reproduce the measured target choices that keep numbers with their units and verbs with their complements.

Insert one narrow induced ordering that prefers keeping numerals attached to an immediately following parenthesized measurement phrase; addresses the primary finding (splits that lose units) with a focused surface trigger so it fires only on those cases.
